capabilities: Draw LaTeX formulas as interactive charts
Drag points, lines and labels to edit formulas
Export pgfplots code and SVG files
extras: No telemetry and no network traffic; optional AI answers locally on 127.0.0.1 with the user's token. MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian renders math as static output, so designing graphs means hand-writing TikZ code with no visual feedback.
summary: Interactive math chart editor that turns LaTeX formulas into draggable 2D/3D graphs with sliders and exports pgfplots code and SVG files.
